contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/development.md conventions: use cn() for className merging, named exports, 'use client' on interactive components, no @mui/material or @vkieu/mui subpaths.
key_patterns: 1) All @vkieu/mui components import from '@vkieu/mui' (no subpaths). 2) Icon polyfill at @/components/ui/icon — import { Icon } from '@/components/ui/icon'. 3) cn() at @/lib/utils for className merging. 4) Button leadingIcon/trailingIcon accept ReactElement; drop size={N} from Icon inside those props. 5) IconButton requires icon={<Icon name='...' />} prop. 6) AssistChip replaces FilterChip for display-only badges; FilterChip is kept ONLY for interactive toggles wired with selected+onSelectedChange. 7) DialogContent already scrolls — never add overflow-y-auto inside it.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/(auth)/ — auth pages; apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/ — all dashboard pages by feature; apps/web/src/components/ — shared components (flow-org, import, rate-cards, ui, assistant); apps/web/src/features/calendar/ — calendar feature; apps/web/.agents/tasks/ — artifact root (never committed)
